```text
# PR #2002: Patch: every opened slot fills the token bars, and a phone-friendly pack opening

Closes #1999

## What changed

### 1. Every opened slot fills both token bars (new ruling R1999000)

Every slot now adds the points of the rarity it rolled to both token bars, on top of what it grants. Before, only a spent slot did.

- **Server.** In `economy/packs.rs`, `slot_bar_points` gives every slot `card_bar_points(slot.rarity)`, pity's force included. In `economy/cosmetic_packs.rs`, `open_cosmetic_pack` gives every slot `cosmetic_bar_points(slot.rarity)`, the rarity it rolled and not the one it fell to. Each opening's `spent` log field now counts `Bars` grants, so it still means "spent".
  - `roll_opening`, `roll_cosmetic_pack` and both opening logs are unchanged, so every logged opening still replays (R1301003, R1306003).
  - The bar sizes (200) and targets (23) are unchanged. The comments in `tokens.rs`, `config.rs`, `math.rs`, `roll.rs` and `crates/server/README.md` now say the 8.65-points-a-pack math holds on any collection.
- **Spec.**
  - New note `spec/rulings/R1999000.md`. It amends R1301002, R1306001, R1661001 and R1953000. R1305000 and R1310003 are reworded to match.
  - §14.3, §14.5 and §14.6 are edited, with an entry in `11-rulings.md`, and `INDEX.md` is regenerated.
- **Client.** No logic changed: `flightsOf` already flies every nonzero `slotPoints` entry. The comments in `bars.ts`, `OpeningBars.tsx`, `PackOpening.tsx`, `CosmeticPacks.tsx`, `packs.ts`, `net/api.ts`, `economy.css` and `apps/web/README.md` no longer say "spent slot".

### 2. The pack opening works on a phone

All of this sits under `@media (max-width: 600px)`; the desktop layout is unchanged.

- **HUD.** In `economy.css` the HUD is compact on a phone: each bar is one line (label, track, caption). A new variable, `--opening-hud-clearance`, sets how far down the scene and the Shop start (10rem on desktop, 5rem on a phone). `packs.css` and `shop.css` read it instead of a fixed 10rem.
- **Cards and buttons.** In `packs.css`, the five cards sit three over two within the screen width, and Reveal all / Close / Done stay pinned at the bottom as 44px buttons. These rules are scoped to `.pack-scene`, so the Shop's own reveal slots are untouched.
- **Shop.** In `shop.css`, `.shop-body` gets `overflow-x: hidden` (see the second departure below).
- Animations are untouched (no new keyframes or transitions). Reduced motion and the #1757 focus trap are unchanged.

## How I tested it

- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server -- api::packs:: api::cosmetic_packs:: api::tokens::`: 53 passed, including the four new `r1999000_…` tests.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server`: every suite passed (1522 + 615 + 153 + …).
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: `1249 rulings, 2849 proofs, … : ok`.
- `cargo jackioh catalog check` and `cargo jackioh patches check`: OK.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: `Internal`, so no patch fragment is needed.
- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, then `pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main …` (the harness's selection): 3883 passed. The six touched or related test files run alone: 142 passed.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`: all clean.
- `pnpm exec cypress run --component --spec cypress/component/pack-opening.cy.tsx,cypress/component/shop-screen.cy.tsx` (binary present): 12 + 8 passing.
  - I swapped the old CSS back in temporarily: the six new phone scene tests and the two new Shop phone tests fail on it, so they catch the old layout. The CSS was then restored.

New tests:
- **Server, card packs:** an opening of all-new cards moves both bars by every slot's points, in the function's answer and on the wire. A duplicate's per-card cosmetic and a global roll's account cosmetic each still add their slot's points.
- **Server, cosmetic packs:** a pack of all-new cosmetics moves both bars. A slot that rolled Legendary or Mythic and fell to Epic adds the points of the tier it rolled.
- **Web:** `R1999000 an opening of all-new cards flies a flight from every slot and fills both bars`.
- **Cypress, card pack scene at 375×667 and 360×640, sealed / mid-reveal / all revealed:**
  - no sideways scroll;
  - the HUD is at most 10% of the screen height and covers no card;
  - mid-reveal, every card is on screen;
  - the pack, each face-down card, Reveal all and Close/Done are at least 44×44 and fully on screen.
- **Cypress, cosmetic opening in the Shop:** the Shop's body starts below the compact HUD and never scrolls sideways.

## Where I departed from the plan
- **Phone clearance is 5rem, not 4rem.** At 360×640, once a bar pays, the HUD gains a reward row (about 79px tall) and covered the scene's title.
- **`.shop-body` gets `overflow-x: hidden`.** After a cosmetic opening on a phone, the Chase Shard bar's burst stays scaled past the bar's right end and gave the Shop body a sideways scrollbar. That conflicts with the issue's "no horizontal scroll". The change applies at every width, because `Shop.test` holds `shop.css` to a single `@media` block. On desktop it changes nothing visible.
- I added the compact-HUD height check to both specs. Without it, the Shop spec passed even on the old CSS.
- I also reworded `crates/server/README.md` line 182 (`slotPoints`, "0 for one not spent"), the `SlotGrant::Bars` doc in `roll.rs`, and R1306001's Hearthstone line. The plan didn't list them, but they stated the old rule.
- In `r1301002_…_grants_cosmetics_or_bar_points`, `bars > 0` became `spent(&slots) > 0`. Every slot now has points, so the old check proved nothing; the new one keeps the test's point that some slot was spent.

## Decisions the issue left open
- **Where the accrual changed:** `packs.rs` and `cosmetic_packs.rs`, not `tokens.rs`, which only holds the points tables.
- **R1661001 is amended too.** Its "a hit adds no bar points" contradicts the acceptance criteria.
- **`slotOutcome` keeps saying "New card".** The points show on the slot's flight into the bars. Adding "+N" to every outcome would mean new translated strings.
- **Shared fixtures are unchanged.** Their slots with `slotPoints` 0 still test that the client draws whatever the server answers. The existing test for an opening that moves neither bar is kept, with its comment updated.
- **Phone layout:** cards three over two rather than a row the player swipes, so the faces stay readable. Only portrait sizes are targeted; landscape phones wider than 600px keep the desktop layout.
- **The Shop's cosmetic reveal** stays a vertical list inside the scrolling Shop body. Only its HUD and sideways scroll changed.

## Worth a second look
- At 360px, once the scene scrolls, the card face switches to its existing compact version because the scrollbar takes width. That is `CardFace`'s own behaviour; I didn't change it.
- **Needs a person:** the issue asks for 375×667 screenshots attached to this PR (card pack sealed, mid-reveal, all revealed with the bars filled, and a cosmetic pack opening). The bot can't reach GitHub. I looked at those states myself in Cypress screenshots, which were not committed.
```

**Issue #1999 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #1999: Patch: every opened slot fills the token bars, and a phone-friendly pack opening
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

Two changes to opening a pack, from the owner.

## 1. The card token bar and the cosmetic token bar fill on new unlocks too

**What happens.** Only a *spent* slot adds points to the two token bars: a card pack's spent duplicate (SPEC §14.3, "A spent duplicate") and a cosmetic pack's slot with nothing left unowned (§14.6, R1306001). A slot that unlocks something new, whether a new card, a duplicate that turns into a new cosmetic or a cosmetic pack slot that grants a new cosmetic, adds nothing. Its `slotPoints` entry is 0, so no points fly from it (`apps/web/src/economy/bars.ts::flightsOf` skips it) and the bars do not move. On a young collection, where most slots are new, the bars barely fill.

**What should happen.** Every opened slot adds the points of the rarity it rolled to both bars, whether it unlocks something new or not:
- In a card pack, the slot's card rarity, pity's force included, in `TOKEN_BAR_POINTS_BY_CARD_RARITY`.
- In a cosmetic pack, the cosmetic rarity it rolled, not the one it fell to, in `TOKEN_BAR_POINTS_BY_COSMETIC_RARITY`.

The slot still grants what it grants today: a new card, a cosmetic, an account cosmetic from the global roll. The bar points come on top. The client then flies every slot's points into the HUD and fills the bars from that answer alone (CLAUDE.md rule 7).

**Where.**
- **Spec.** Amend §14.3 ("A spent duplicate …"), §14.5 ("Spent duplicates (§14.3) fill two bars …" and the sentence on sizes, which says "on a collection that is mostly owned") and §14.6 ("If nothing at all is unowned, the slot gives bar points …"). Add a ruling note in this issue's block that amends R1301002, R1306001 and R1953000 (CLAUDE.md rule 3; `docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers).
- **Server.** In `crates/server/src/economy/tokens.rs`, accrue points for every slot, not only spent ones. `slotPoints` in the opening's answer becomes nonzero for every slot. The opening's log and `roll_opening` stay unchanged, so every logged opening still replays (R1301003).
- **Sizes.** `CARD_TOKEN_BAR_SIZE` and `COSMETIC_TOKEN_BAR_SIZE` stay 200 and the targets stay 23 packs. The R1953000 math already assumes every slot counts ("on a complete collection, every slot spent"), so after this change the targets hold for every account, not only a complete one. Update the wording in `economy/math.rs` and §14.5 to match. Changing the sizes is out of scope.
- **Client.** Update the header comments in `apps/web/src/economy/OpeningBars.tsx`, `bars.ts` and `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`, which say "spent duplicate" or "spent slot". `flightsOf` needs no logic change, because the server now sends nonzero points.

**Acceptance.**
- A server test opens a card pack whose slots are all new cards: each bar gains the slots' rarity points, and `slotPoints` holds those points for every slot.
- A server test does the same for a cosmetic pack whose slots all grant new cosmetics.
- A server test shows that a duplicate that becomes a new per-card cosmetic, or an account cosmetic from the global roll, still adds its slot's points.
- `OpeningBars.test.tsx` or `PackOpening.test.tsx`: an opening of all-new cards flies a flight from every slot and fills both bars.
- The new ruling's proving tests are named after it, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## 2. The pack-opening scene works on a phone

**What happens.** The scene (`PackScene` in `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`, styled by `packs.css` and `pack-object.css`, with the bars' HUD in `economy/economy.css`) is laid out for a desktop:
- `.pack-scene[data-hud]` reserves `padding-top: 10rem` under the pinned HUD, which takes a large part of a phone's height.
- Each `.pack-slot` is at least `clamp(7rem, 17vw, 11rem)` wide, so at 375px the five cards wrap into rows of two and the player scrolls to find the third row.
- The HUD (`.opening-hud`, up to 32rem wide with both bars stacked) sits over the top of the scrolled cards.
- The scene's actions (skip all, close, Equip) can end up below the fold.

**What should happen.** At phone sizes (360×640 and 375×667, portrait), opening a card pack or a cosmetic pack is comfortable:
- There is no horizontal scroll.
- All five revealed cards are visible together, or in a deliberate compact layout, for example a tighter grid or a single row the player swipes.
- The HUD is compact and never covers a card the player is flipping.
- The tear and swipe target and each card are easy tap targets.
- Skip all and Close are reachable without hunting.

Desktop stays as it is. Keep the existing rules: animations move only transform and opacity (`PackObject.test.tsx` holds the sheets to that), reduced motion still shows the results at once, and the modal focus trap (#1757) is unchanged.

**Acceptance.**
- A component or pixel spec (`pnpm --dir e2e test:component`) or a web unit test covers the phone layout: at a 375px-wide viewport, no horizontal overflow, and the HUD sits clear of the slots.
- Screenshots at 375×667 of a card pack opening (sealed, mid-reveal, all revealed with the bars filled) and a cosmetic pack opening, attached to the pull request (the `ui-walkthrough` skill).
````
